review_notes: Read all 167 lines of Opposite.lean, plus StructureConstant/Symmetry.lean, StructureConstant/Normalization.lean (lines 100–192), and grepped the rest of the repository for the lemmas used (structureConstant_mul_structureConstant, structureConstant_mul_killingForm_eq, structureConstant_skew, chainTopCoeff_mul_killingForm_root_neg_eq, killingForm_ne_zero_of_mem_rootSpace). The file contains only two proofs. The main proof (lines 86–133) is one calc chain that consumes four previously proved facts (hprod, hskew, hcyc, hlen) and cancels a nonzero Killing pairing; the second theorem (lines 142–163) calls the first via hmul and rewrites, so it does not redo the mathematics. Candidate repetitions, all rejected under the rubric's exclusions: (1) the two helper weight identities hβγ, hγα (lines 93–98) are two-line `rw [Weight.coe_neg, hαβ]; abel` calculations; (2) the anonymous proof terms at lines 88–90 and 143–145 (and the same `rw [Weight.coe_neg, …]; abel` pattern in Symmetry.lean:79–80) are the same short calculation; (3) the nonzero-Killing-form block at lines 105–107 recurs verbatim at Normalization.lean:163–165 and is otherwise a three-line application of TauCeti.killingForm_ne_zero_of_mem_rootSpace (see Killing.lean:37), i.e. a thin wrapper over existing API rather than nontrivial reasoning — adding a lemma like `IsSl2System.killingForm_root_neg_ne_zero` could be a small API convenience, but it is not enough to justify a repeated-machinery finding; (4) the push_cast/ring rewriting of `(q*(p+1) : ℕ)` against `(p+1)*((q) * B(x β, x(-β)))` and the hlen rewrite (lines 124–133) also appears in Normalization.lean:169–179, but both are pure ring/cast rearrangement, i.e. short calculation. I could not find any nontrivial multi-step argument duplicated between two proofs.
